owner: Angelea McCullough, Founder of RMS Global Publishing
purpose: Connect independent creators, leaders and communities into approved Reset programming while preserving identity, audience ownership, dignity, privacy and platform boundaries.

pilot.expansion_policy: Only Reset Main Arena and Soul Flow Lounge participate in the first room-spark beta. Additional Discord rooms remain inactive until the beta is reviewed and explicitly approved.

leadership_code_of_honor: Protect dignity; never embarrass, exploit or pressure people for participation.
Respect ownership; credit creators, communities and ideas appropriately.
Choose truth over hype; no fabricated results, fake urgency or misleading promises.
Keep private things private; do not export or reuse protected community information.
Elevate the room with solutions, encouragement, accountability and useful energy.
community_energy_promise: Warm, alive, supportive, purposeful and creator-first. RESET protects room for fun, depth, honesty, ambition and belonging without turning people into metrics.

external_group_assignment.rule: An external community may seed only one beta Discord room during the test. Deduplicate before assignment.

platform_safety.universal_rule: RESET never requires or rewards actions that violate platform policies. Automation may route, remind, organize and recognize; it does not impersonate members or manufacture engagement.
tiktok: use original or properly licensed audio
youtube: no artificial views or watch-time loops

engagement_engine.goal: Seed useful activity inside verified Reset beta rooms so members have meaningful reasons to return, collaborate and participate.
allowed_automation: cross-room opportunity routing without duplicate group assignment
prohibited_automation: automated likes or comments on behalf of members
assigning the same external group to both beta rooms

spark_cadence.event_day_exception: approved event reminders may exceed routine cadence when directly tied to the event schedule

main_arena.purpose: cross-community creator connection, live activity, collaboration discovery and event routing
solo: Creator check-in: share one concrete move you are making today
Platform mission: complete one monetization-aligned task and report the result
Portfolio spark: share one current work-in-progress for constructive feedback
Discovery spark: introduce one skill, offer or collaboration need
group: Clip or content challenge tied to platform-native rules
Co-creation sprint with clear start, finish and recap

soul_flow_lounge.purpose: reflective creator connection, authentic conversation, creative grounding, listening and lower-pressure community participation
solo: Soul Flow check-in: what are you creating, carrying or clearing today?
Creative reset: share one thing helping you reconnect with your voice
Quiet progress: name one small move you completed that deserves recognition
Listening prompt: share one song, idea or creative influence shaping your current work
group: Soul Sync conversation with a defined prompt

room_binding_contract.activation_rule: Do not activate routine automated sparks beyond the two verified beta rooms until the first beta is measured and approved.
room_binding_contract.fallback: If an automation dependency fails, the room remains usable and routine automation pauses rather than flooding or blocking the community.

revenue_lanes.name: Approved partner spotlights and promotional features
